sections.appearance: She has ankle-length white hair cut into blunt bangs. Her eyes are a bright purple. Noa's figure is soft and pronounced. A pair of mechanical devices resembling Scouter lenses sit upon her ears, though their purpose is unknown. Halo ==== Her Halo resembles Yuuka's in its mechanical appearance. However, hers is white, has a blue inner circle, and a blue-colored portion on her right-hand side. Uniform ==== Noa's uniform consists of white and blue low heel boots, black tights, a pleated white skirt and blazer with a tech adorned jacket hung over her arms. Underneath the blazer is a white dress-shirt and blue tie with her Millennium access card clipped onto the blazer's side pocket. Gym version: She wore a light blue uniform jacket zipped down to the chest, a dark blue T-shirt underneath, and shorts with two white stripes on the sides. Her shoes were the same as the original. Firearm ==== She uses a white STI Apeiro 2011 with a black grip. A white and blue Flux Raider brace is installed on the gun allowing it to act like a pistol-caliber carbine. The Millenium logo is imprinted near the stock. The Tokyo Marui label is imprinted on the chassis just above the reserve magazine.

sections.personality: Noa is a helpful member of Seminar. Utilizing her incredible memory, she is able to record nearly everything that's been said during meetings, as well as details of locations she has been to that others may overlook entirely. This leaves her as a capable investigator in addition to an observer. She often poses a calming front and often has a subtle smile that she holds for long periods with ease. Noa has been friends with Yuuka for some time and periodically teases her, especially regarding her feelings towards Sensei. However, she is also the only member of Seminar capable of intimidating Koyuki into cooperation or compliance. Her hobbies include poetry, though she often uses complex or archaic terminology in her writing. She lives as an ascetic, believing that a minimalist lifestyle contributes to her ability to be an impartial observer. Appearance === She has ankle-length white hair cut into blunt bangs.
